no_candidate_model_prompt_backend_or_hoo.mechanism: placing and releasing a hold require the same recorded three-field authority plus the same legal matter id, a class-scoped hold fails closed on a candidate with no declared class, and the register re-derives every placement digest so an edited hold is refused
